name: crewmeter
description: Local, read-only tracker of how your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) actually performed: landed rate, 14-day rework, tokens and your attention, per agent combination.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts src/collect-worker.ts --target=node --packages=external --outdir=dist && cp src/aggregate.js src/trend.js dist/
